facts.fact: La Nation reports over 53,000 parcels registered across Porto-Novo in the e-Foncier Bénin digital cadastral database, with Cadastre registration certificates being distributed and 8,777 updates integrated.
La Nation reports 10,495 parcels in Porto-Novo are under field verification for integration into the e-Foncier Bénin database and data updating continues in the 4th and 5th arrondissements.
